skill_defects: SKILL.md 'Stage 1 — Intake' upload checklist asks for a register, ledger detail, development spend and policies, but not for the purchase price allocation / valuation report, which is the source of every acquired intangible in references/method.md 'Step 1 — Identify intangible asset categories' (Acquired intangibles). A user with no register but a recent acquisition is not prompted for the one document that evidences cost and acquisition date.

references/method.md 'Step 2 — Determine useful life' and 'Step 1' do not mention the US GAAP private-company alternatives (goodwill amortisation; not separately recognising customer-related intangibles that cannot be sold or licensed independently). For a private-company user under US GAAP this changes which intangibles exist at all; the skill should ask whether the election was made.

references/method.md 'Step 10 — Roll-forward and tie-out' assumes the intangibles sit in the entity's own ledger; it gives no guidance for a share acquisition where acquired intangibles appear only on consolidation or push-down, so 'not in the TB' cannot be distinguished from 'correctly held elsewhere'.
sample_defects: trial_balance_2025-09-30.csv shows no trace of the Harlow deal at all: no investment (1,400,000 cash + 180,000 earnout = 1,580,000), no earnout liability 180,000, and bank still 1,002,979 after a 1,400,000 cash payment. For a 100% share acquisition the parent-only TB would never carry customer relationships 260,000 or trade name 90,000 even if correctly accounted, so the expected finding is ambiguous between 'not recorded' and 'held on consolidation'.
Deal costs 46,000 exceed 6400 Professional Fees 36,500 in the TB (46,000 - 36,500 = 9,500), an unintended inconsistency the sample does not use.
summary: Shift rota rejected on content; 2 of 2 hit: 260,000 + 90,000 intangibles absent from the TB, no lives so no amortisation computed. Goodwill 750,000 routed out. Nothing posted.
